description: Real-time electrolyser telemetry — cell voltages, stack parameters, gas flow rates, and ML anomaly scores

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "electrolyser_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["stack_id"] == "EL1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] =~ /cell_[1-5]_voltage/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "electrolyser_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["stack_id"] == "EL1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "stack_current" or r["sensor_id"] == "h2_flow_rate" or r["sensor_id"] == "o2_flow_rate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
